mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_item_links (source_id, target_id, link_type) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{targetId}, #{linkType}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, target_id, link_type) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS linkId, l.link_type AS linkType, t.id AS targetId, t.key AS targetKey, t.title AS targetTitle, t.issue_type AS targetIssueType, t.common_status AS targetCommonStatus FROM work_item_links l JOIN work_items t ON t.id = l.target_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE l.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY l.created_at ASC, l.id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM work_item_links WHERE (source_id = #{sourceId} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND link_type = #{linkType}) OR (source_id = #{targetId} AND target_id = #{sourceId} AND link_type = #{inverseType})
